shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/pillar carved in relief
repeated small figures in a row
carving covering the full face of a standing stone
justification: Both are upright slabs carved with figural relief in stacked zones, and both include profile creatures and a frontally presented head, but these are near-universal choices for monumental stelae. A shows a purely zoomorphic programme (row of arched forms, quadrupeds, fox-like and bird-like beasts, a chevron band) in low, flat, schematic relief, while B is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorph in elaborate headdress and costume surrounded by dense scroll and mask ornament in deep, naturalistic modelling; no specific motif or relationship recurs.
